integrity: Fully described analytic proof and standalone exact-rational verifier; claimed novelty remains subject to external publication-precedence review.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional unit harmonic oscillator, two elliptic symplectic-Euler steps, stationary symmetric two-state Markov switching. Mean-square not almost-sure growth; finite-horizon comparisons do not establish practical blow-up times.
title: Markov-correlation endpoints are the only stable schedules for two symplectic-Euler steps
